Probe power must be 5 V. Do not copy the Manta connector positions or its five-pin probe order.
FAN6 and FAN7 are always-on outputs; FAN0-FAN5 are controllable. Fan negative is a switched return.
X Hall -> EBB36 PB6; Y Hall -> EBB36 PB7. Extruder, hotend and toolhead fans also connect to EBB36.
Source: BTT Octopus Pro V1.1 pinout + your actual board photo. Electrical checks and sensor behavior remain pending.
